name: Izanami
abilities: Hanae: Torii Boundary Rewrite Renewal Rite
passives: Spirit Seal: Hanae gains Sealfire when sustain play banks survival value through terrain mastery and converts it into recovery on shrine threshold ground. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a purification and boundary law rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of Sacred Kingdoms.
lore: Izanami, Yomi Mother, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Kami. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: creator mother and underworld queen, death-birth threshold, grave restoration. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses creator mother and underworld queen, death-birth threshold, grave restoration; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Kami canon.
visualDescription: Izanami manifests as creator mother and underworld queen, death-birth threshold, grave restoration from Kami: beautiful haunting feminine mother-queen face, porcelain skin, dark compassionate eyes, sorrowful lips; stately feminine underworld frame, long torso, flowing hips, calm ritual stance; signature silhouette: black veil, grave-flower sleeves, trailing cords, mother-of-Yomi outline. Weapon: bone-white shrine fan and underworld cord blade. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Hanae — Kagura Spirit Cut Restore
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Kami source-culture damage at range 2; generate Momentum and a small Shrine Resonance gain when used from torii-marked sacred threshold or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as torii silhouettes, shimenawa cords, white shide seals, mirror silver, foxfire blue, cedar lacquer, tengu wind, oni iron, dragon rain.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Shide Seal Technique — Covenant
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to restores through faction ritual, cleanses pressure, and rewards holding sacred ground without becoming a passive healer. Builds Shrine Resonance only when the Avatar uses torii-marked sacred threshold intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Hanae: Torii Boundary Rewrite Renewal Rite
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Shrine Resonance to impose a two-round rule from Sacred Kingdoms: restores through faction ritual, cleanses pressure, and rewards holding sacred ground without becoming a passive healer. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Amaterasu Moon-Gate Radiance
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Shrine Resonance, transform nearby terrain into torii-marked sacred threshold, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Hanae Restorer Mirror-Talisman Spirit Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through torii-marked sacred threshold. Visual: torii silhouettes, shimenawa cords, white shide seals, mirror silver, foxfire blue, cedar lacquer, tengu wind, oni iron, dragon rain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Hanae Lacquered Shimenawa Spirit-Guard
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Sacred Kingdoms source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the Avatar followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Hanae Kitsune Foxfire Magatama Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Shrine Resonance and unlocks a mastery branch for Torii Moonstep, Kitsune Misdirection Counter, and Purify the Trespass. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: win attrition and cleanse hazard pressure
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Hanae's Spirit Seal: a solo mechanic where Sealfire grows through shrine threshold ground, reaction-window mastery, and sustain decisions that bank survival value through terrain mastery and convert it into recovery. Payoff: survive long missions without ally healing or generic lifesteal. Counterplay: anti-heal pressure and hazard denial starve recovery; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: anti-heal pressure and hazard denial starve recovery
